source: Cleanview, 'Bypassing the Grid' full report, https://cleanview.co/reports/behind-the-meter-data-centers/full-report (read 2026-10-24, data to ~mid-2026; page not redistributed)
basis: Market share by OEM of permitted/identified behind-the-meter equipment (~27 GW of ~90 GW planned). Cleanview does not report shares by technology; the split below is ours.

quotes.caterpillar: Caterpillar has the highest market share (33%) of projects we track. We found more than 8.8 GW of permitted Caterpillar engines and Solar Turbines.
quotes.solar: We identified 122 permitted Solar Turbines installations with a combined capacity of 2.7 GW.
quotes.combined_cycle: only one of the behind-the-meter data center projects we reviewed plans to use heavy-duty turbines onsite
